title: seed-sites
responsibility: Creates two synthetic applications from one template, with the checkouts of the first, for the report fixtures.

outputs.name: siteRoot
outputs.description: Filesystem path returned by site('alpha-project') for the alpha fixture root; the script deletes and recreates this directory from the shared template, then uses it as the main repository. It is the alpha repository root, not any of the generated checkout paths.

outputs.name: foreignRoot
outputs.description: Filesystem path returned by site('beta-project') for the foreign fixture root; the script deletes and recreates this application from the shared template with its own repository URL. It is separate from the alpha repository.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A filesystem call or Git command can throw during module execution, stopping fixture creation partway through.
